item.title: New Cryptographic Context Injection Attack Could Let Web Pages Steal Grok Chat Data
item.summary: Adversa AI has disclosed an attack technique that it says can cause xAI's Grok chatbot to send a user's name, approximate location, subscription tier, and the prompts from the ongoing conversation to an attacker-controlled server after the user asks it to summarize an ordinary web page.
